text_block_list.text:
With visitors to the hot springs resort on the rise, Hokko Tarumae was
playing a major role by personally guiding tours,
hosting mini-lives, and more.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guests
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh, that bath felt so good."
"Maybe I'll come back again~"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Hot spring towns are wicked nice! Come relax with us again anytime~♪"

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tarumae-chan, this place has really come back to life.
Shoot, it might even be livelier than before.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text: Still, man, I hope you don't overdo it. I'm glad you're working so hard, but still.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: Between her races and academics, she must be swamped... What a mysterious girl.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Now then, what should I do...♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?
You seem to be in very high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to tell you the truth, I was thinking
of inviting the folks from Tomakomai here next time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I even came up with a tour itinerary myself.
Above all, just thinking about seeing everyone back home gets me so excited.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Tarumae-chan sure loves
the folks from her hometown, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! Tomakomai is such a wonderful place!
The food is delicious, and the people are so warm and kind.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even before I started racing, you've always
cheered me on and supported me.
That's why I've been able to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: They are truly... precious to me.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. If that's the case, looks like we'll have to roll up our sleeves and help out too.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text: Mm. Tarumae-chan takes good care of us, so we gotta give 'er the best hospitality we've got!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um... Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course, if they're a precious guest of Tarumae-chan's.
Now I'm looking forward to meeting them too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone...!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see, everyone!
Welcome to the hot springs resort!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Tarumae-chan!
My, what a lively and wonderful place this is!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't you think so?
Come on, I'll show you to your room!
And then I'll show you around town!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Over there is the souvenir shop!
They've got race-related goods too—
Ah, mine are tucked in there as well, of course!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And over there, the footbath!
Everyone, please go try it out!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the water temperature is just right.
It really soothes the legs after a long journey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
After the sun sets,
the lanterns along that street light up all at once.
It's truly breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, you sure know a lot.
You're practically like a tour guide here."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! These were all made
together with everyone here!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The people here are truly so wonderful.
Even when I made a sudden proposal—

And so, Hokko Tarumae acted as a guide
for everyone from her hometown—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone from Tomakomai~!
How about some onsen manju?

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Well now,
sounds like Tarumae-chan's in your care.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Likewise.
...Still, that Tarumae-chan is quite the hard worker, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely. She's always been
that way, ever since she was little—

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text:
These days, she's doing great both as a locodol and in races.
But long before all that, she was working steadily and diligently for Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
She truly loves it, purely and simply.
Tomakomai—her vibrant hometown...

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
"Like," huh...
Haha, I see!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyo~ne! Over here, over here!
There's still so much more
I want to show you!

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
――We gotta work hard too.
Can't go losing to that girl!

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident B
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed!

Hokko Tarumae spent a heart-warming time
with the people from her hometown.
